description: This file defines the JwtService class responsible for generating, parsing, and validating JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) within the application. It handles secret key management, token creation with custom claims, and validation checks.

classes.name: JwtService
classes.description: Service to generate and validate JWT tokens, managing secret keys, and extracting claims from tokens.

methods.name: getSigningKey
methods.description: Generates the SecretKey used for signing tokens, supporting both base64-encoded secrets and raw strings.

methods.name: extractUsername
methods.description: Extracts the username (subject) claim from a JWT token.

methods.name: extractExpiration
methods.description: Extracts the expiration date from a JWT token.

methods.name: extractClaim
methods.description: Generic method to extract any claim from the token using a claims resolver function.

methods.name: parseAllClaims
methods.description: Parses all claims from the JWT token after validating its signature.

methods.name: isTokenExpired
methods.description: Checks whether the token has expired.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for the specified user, including optional extra claims.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Validates whether the token is valid for the given user and not expired.
